from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections import Counter

_WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z']+")


def top_words(text: str, k: int) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    """Return the ``k`` most common words in ``text`` as ``(word, count)`` tuples.

    Counting is case-insensitive and a word is a maximal run of ASCII letters and
    apostrophes, so ``"don't"`` is one word and ``"well-known"`` is two. Results are
    sorted by count descending, then alphabetically.
    """
    counts = Counter(match.group().lower() for match in _WORD_RE.finditer(text))
    return sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))[:max(k, 0)]
